title: Trust List
description: A list of trusted issuers for digital identity verification

entity_type.description: The high-level category of the entity acting as the issuer

data.description: PEM-encoded X.509 certificate used for document signing

format.description: Format of the certificate (currently only PEM is supported)

certificates.description: Array of certificates issued with the same subject key identifier with the most recent first. It is expected that only one certificate per subject is present, so if only updating the expiration date, the old certificate should be removed when adding the new one.
